Summary: US-01: User Authentication & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Description:
*User Story:* As a user or admin, I want to securely log in with JWT tokens so that I can access role-specific dashboards and endpoints.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Implement password hashing with bcrypt and JWT token generation.
2. Provide login/register REST endpoints for Student and Admin roles.
3. Secure restricted endpoints using FastAPI Depends(get_current_user).

Summary: US-02: FastAPI Backend Core Architecture & Health Endpoints
Description:
*User Story:* As a developer, I want a structured FastAPI server with CORS and health-check endpoints so that the frontend can reliably communicate with backend services.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Modular folder structure with config, routes, services, and models.
2. Configure CORS middleware for local frontend port (Vite/React).
3. /api/health endpoint returning database and memory status.

Summary: US-03: Document Ingestion & Text Chunking Pipeline
Description:
*User Story:* As an admin, I want to upload official government scheme PDFs and parse them into structured text chunks so that they can be prepared for vectorization.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Extract text and metadata from PDF files using PyMuPDF / LangChain loaders.
2. Apply recursive character text splitting with 500-token chunk size and 50-token overlap.
3. Store document metadata and raw file status in SQLite database.

Summary: US-04: Dense Vector Storage & ChromaDB Indexing
Description:
*User Story:* As a system, I want to generate multilingual vector embeddings from text chunks and store them in ChromaDB so that semantic similarity search can be performed.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Initialize persistent ChromaDB vector store collection.
2. Generate dense embeddings using multilingual embedding models.
3. Store document ID, chunk text, and source page as vector metadata.

*User Story:* As a citizen, I want the system to automatically detect whether my query is in English, Hindi, Hinglish, or Odia so that queries are routed to the proper language pipeline.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Implement fast rule-based script detection for Devanagari (Hindi) and Odia scripts.
2. Classify Latin-script queries as standard English vs Hinglish transliteration.
3. Return detected language code with confidence score.

Summary: US-06: Responsive Chat Interface & Starter Query Cards
Description:
*User Story:* As a citizen, I want a clean, responsive React chat interface with starter query cards across languages so that I can easily ask questions on mobile or desktop.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Chat window supporting real-time message stream with user & assistant bubbles.
2. Language selector dropdown and quick starter prompts in 4 languages.
3. Loading indicators and clean error states during API latency.

Summary: US-07: Sparse Retrieval with BM25 Indexing
Description:
*User Story:* As a search engine, I want BM25 keyword indexing across scheme terms, numbers, and acronyms to capture exact lexical matches alongside semantic embeddings.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Tokenize document chunks with multilingual stopword filtering.
2. Build in-memory / persistent BM25 index on ingestion.
3. Return top-K BM25 scored document IDs for incoming search queries.

Summary: US-08: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) Hybrid Retriever
Description:
*User Story:* As a retrieval pipeline, I want to combine dense vector rankings and sparse BM25 scores using RRF so that the system achieves high recall across mixed queries.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Implement RRF algorithm with configurable smoothing parameter (k=60).
2. Merge vector candidates and BM25 candidates into a unified ranked list.
3. Deduplicate overlapping chunks and return top ranked candidates.

Summary: US-09: LLM Prompt Orchestration & Zero-Hallucination Guardrails
Description:
*User Story:* As a citizen, I want responses strictly generated from retrieved document context with fallback messages for out-of-domain queries so that no false information is given.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Design system prompt enforcing strict grounded answers only from context.
2. Trigger standard polite fallback response when similarity threshold < 0.65.
3. Integrate Gemini LLM API client with temperature = 0.1 for high precision.

Summary: US-10: Admin Document Management & Metadata Tagging UI
Description:
*User Story:* As an administrator, I want a web interface to view all ingested documents, verify status/checksum, and delete outdated schemes.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Admin table showing uploaded files, upload date, status, and chunk count.
2. PDF upload drag-and-drop zone with instant ingestion trigger.
3. Delete button to remove document chunks from SQLite and ChromaDB.

*User Story:* As a retrieval pipeline, I want a cross-encoder reranking step to re-score top candidate chunks and optimize Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Pass query-chunk pairs through lightweight cross-encoder model.
2. Re-order top 10 candidates to select top 3 most relevant context passages.
3. Benchmark latency overhead to ensure under 50ms per query.

Summary: US-12: Source Grounding & Interactive Citation References
Description:
*User Story:* As a user, I want clickable citation badges attached to each answer section showing the exact page and source scheme document.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Extract source document title and page number from chunk metadata.
2. Render interactive badge chips in chat bubbles.
3. Clicking badge opens drawer or preview modal showing the cited document excerpt.

Summary: US-13: Unanswered Query Analytics & Admin Feedback Loop
Description:
*User Story:* As an admin, I want to review unanswered or low-confidence user queries so that knowledge gaps in documents can be identified and uploaded.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Log fallback queries with timestamp and detected language to database.
2. Admin analytics page displaying top missing query topics and search volume.
3. One-click button to tag a missing query to an uploaded scheme document.

*User Story:* As a developer, I want an automated evaluation test suite with adversarial test cases to measure multilingual recall and end-to-end latency.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Create test dataset of 100 question-answer pairs across English, Hindi, Hinglish, Odia.
2. Compute Recall@5, MRR, and response latency across all 4 retrieval strategies.
3. Generate automated markdown evaluation benchmark report.

Summary: US-15: Docker Containerization & Production Deployment Config
Description:
*User Story:* As a DevOps engineer, I want Docker Compose multi-container setup (frontend + backend + chromadb) for one-click deployment.

*Acceptance Criteria:*
1. Write multi-stage Dockerfile for FastAPI backend and Vite React frontend.
2. Create docker-compose.yml with volume persistence for ChromaDB and SQLite.
3. Configure environment variables and healthcheck restart policies.
